label: NF-kB activation in lymphocyte receptor signalling
reason: TCR, CD40, CD27, TNFSF and NIK/IKK paths all converge on canonical and non-canonical NF-kB in lymphocytes, plus IKK-deficiency diseases.

label: Cell-cell junctions and epithelial polarity
reason: Adherens junctions, desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, cadherins and apical-basal polarity; the cardiac members are intercalated-disc adhesion.

label: FGFR downstream signalling cascades
reason: FRS, SHC, PI3K and PLCgamma cascades for FGFR1-4 and Klotho ligand binding; ERBB2 PLCG1 is a close RTK analogue.

label: Eye and inner ear sensory organ development
reason: Eye and inner ear morphogenesis and function, linked by shared sensory-organ genes (stereocilia/microvillus actin bundles, connexins, Norrin-FZD4 barriers); bile duct is a stray.

label: snoRNP-guided RNA modification and Cajal bodies
reason: rRNA/tRNA/snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation, snoRNP and telomerase RNP assembly and Cajal body localisation.

label: Embryonic axial and neural tube patterning
reason: Neural plate/tube D-V patterning, somitogenesis, axial mesoderm, hindbrain rhombomeres and spinal neuron fate specification.

label: NO-cGMP regulation of vascular tone
reason: eNOS activation and trafficking, BH4, cGMP signalling, smooth muscle relaxation and systemic blood pressure.

label: Wnt/beta-catenin and Notch signalling
reason: Destruction-complex/beta-catenin and Notch processing/NICD transcription, two crosstalking developmental cell-fate pathways; gamma-secretase RIP ties in p75NTR and ERBB4.

label: Polyubiquitination and proteasomal degradation
reason: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain formation, E3 ligases, deubiquitinases and proteasomal protein catabolism.

label: Monocyte recruitment and inflammatory activation
reason: Monocyte chemotaxis, MCP-1, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules and inflammatory response; hyaluronan, RAGE and scavenger members are inflammatory monocyte cues.

label: Nucleocytoplasmic transport via nuclear pore
reason: mRNA, ribosome, protein and inositol phosphate traffic through the NPC and NPC assembly/disassembly; mitochondrial RNA import is a stray.

label: p53-mediated DNA damage response
reason: TP53 regulation and targets, p14ARF, p21, G1/G2 checkpoints, radiation response, apoptosis and senescence.

label: B cell development and BCR signalling
reason: BCR signalling, B cell differentiation, proliferation and homeostasis; two myeloid/inhibitory BTM modules are a small minority.

label: Neural tube and axial patterning
reason: Neural plate and tube regionalisation, floor plate, axial mesoderm, hindbrain and spinal neuron fate specification.

label: Axon guidance and peripheral/cranial nerve development
reason: Axon guidance, cranial and sensory ganglia, peripheral neuron differentiation and neuronal migration.

label: Innate immune NF-kB and MAPK activation
reason: TLR, NOD1/2, TNF and IRAK/TRAF6/TAK1 activating IKK, NF-kB, JNK and p38.

label: Renal water/salt homeostasis and osmoregulation
reason: Vasopressin, aquaporins, aldosterone, renal sodium transport, osmotic stress responses and blood pressure.

label: Scavenger receptor-mediated clearance
reason: Scavenger receptor classes, apoptotic cell and immune complex clearance and hyaluronan uptake (stabilin, a class H scavenger receptor); protein import is a stray.

label: Dopaminergic/catecholamine neurotransmission and reward
reason: Dopamine synthesis, transport, receptors and DARPP-32 signalling, plus behavioural responses to drugs of abuse.

label: Kidney and nephron development
reason: Ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme, nephron segments, glomerulus and podocytes; a couple of generic members are minor.

label: Neurotrophin/TRK receptor signalling
reason: NGF-TRKA and NTF3-NTRK3 activation and downstream RAS/ERK, ERK5, p38, PI3K, PLCgamma and CREB.

label: cGAS-STING, interferon-beta and CCL5 induction
reason: Cytosolic DNA sensing via cGAS-STING/TREX1 driving IFN-beta, antiviral defence and CCL5/dendritic cell cytokines.

label: Heat shock response and chaperone protein folding
reason: HSF1 activation and attenuation, protein refolding, UPRmt, chaperone-mediated autophagy and aggrephagy.

label: Antimicrobial peptides and mucosal defence
reason: Defensins, antimicrobial peptide production, bacterial/fungal killing, metal sequestration and microbiota modulation.

label: VEGF/Tie2-driven angiogenesis
reason: VEGFR2 and neuropilin signalling, Tie2, endothelial proliferation, migration and sprouting angiogenesis.

label: Fucosylated glycans and selectin ligands
reason: GDP-fucose synthesis, blood-group glycans and CDG transporters, plus sulfation and leukocyte/HSC selectin-mediated rolling and homing.

label: Vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
reason: Smooth muscle contraction and relaxation, vasoconstriction, cGMP effects and blood pressure regulation.

label: Germline development and oocyte-to-embryo transition
reason: Spermatogenesis, piRNA transposon silencing, PGC specification, oocyte, MZT and zygotic genome activation; a few generic members.

label: Hindbrain/brainstem and autonomic neural development
reason: Hindbrain and pons development, cranial nerves, neural crest autonomic/enteric development and brainstem functions such as respiration and suckling.

label: FGFR downstream signalling cascades
reason: FRS, SHC, PI3K and PLCgamma cascades for FGFR1-4 and betaKlotho ligand binding.

label: Planar cell polarity and non-canonical Wnt
reason: PCP protein localisation, Wnt/Ca2+ and Wnt5a-ROR2 signalling driving convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis.

label: Ionotropic synaptic transmission
reason: AMPA/kainate and nicotinic receptor activation, presynaptic calcium channels, GIRK and GABA signalling, synaptic plasticity.

label: TGF-beta/SMAD signalling and its regulation
reason: TGFBR and SMAD activation, cancer mutants, negative regulation, activin/AMH and RUNX3 targets.

label: Skin and ectodermal appendage development
reason: Epidermis, hair follicle, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland, taste papilla and melanocyte development.

label: Cilia, centrosome and microtubule organisation
reason: Ciliogenesis, IFT, motile cilia, sperm flagella and photoreceptor cilia linked via centriole/basal body to centrosome and mitotic spindle organisation.

label: Stress MAPK (JNK/p38) and AP-1 response
reason: TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation, AP-1 and immediate-early growth factor/TNF response programs.

label: Motile cilia and sperm flagellar motility
reason: Dynein arm and axonemal assembly, cilium beating, mucociliary clearance and sperm motility/mitochondrial sheath.

label: Endothelial shear stress and leukocyte adhesion
reason: Endothelial PIEZO1/PECAM1 shear mechanotransduction and integrin-mediated leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, linked through PECAM1 and integrin activation at the vessel wall.

label: SUMOylation and nuclear pore transport
reason: SUMO conjugation pathway and NPC-mediated transport, linked specifically by the NPC as a SUMO hub (RanBP2 E3, SENPs, SUMO-RanGAP1).

label: Sphingolipid and ceramide metabolism
reason: De novo sphingolipid synthesis, sphingomyelin turnover and ceramide production; obsolete generic lipid terms fit.
